guide_check.rounding_note: 190,000 implies 14.37%; 14.0% gives 185,078 (about 185,000); exactly 1/7 gives 188,855 (about 189,000). The guide overstates its own 'about 14%' row by 1,100-5,000 members.

vintage.older_vintages_available: No. Only the 2026-10-07 snapshot of A/B was downloaded; the Internet Archive was offline (HTTP 'Temporarily Offline') on 2026-11-02, so no older B vintage could be fetched. Evidence of upward revision comes from (i) the within-snapshot recency profile and (ii) DHCS's own April-2026 figure (vintage date not stated) vs the same month in this snapshot.

all_plan.note: Kaiser, Molina, SCAN and out-of-county plan members counted as exposed; PACE excluded (stays in PACE). Multiples 0.5-2.0 are a range, not an estimate. Statewide pattern (IEHP 10.0% of enrolment, 5-7% of movers) implies non-IEHP plans' per-member rate 1.5x-2.1x IEHP's [ESTIMATE: arithmetic on S35/S32].

medicaid_flag.interpretation_M: M = accepts new managed-care Medicaid patients only. These records are FFS-enrolled (they are in E) but declare no new FFS patients: a partial view of providers on the guide's Group A list who would not take moving members. N = no new Medicaid at all. Because the flag is self-reported, present on 15% of billing rows and on no non-billing IE row, M+N is a floor on declining providers, not a rate.

age_shares_note: Statewide shares (251,000 of 1.9 million under 21; 28.8% age 50+ of the expansion group) applied to IEHP scenarios; ESTIMATE, not an IE count; no age restriction on demand.
